entries.reason: Tile animation and render traversal are map-owned systems with graphics as a borrowed service.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: Visible TileLayer entities in the current ECS/map world.
entries.view: Generation-checked TileLayer view plus renderer-owned graphics batch context.
entries.read_set: Tile layer visibility, tile animation clocks, atlas metadata and map transforms.
entries.write_set: Tile animation time state and graphics batch submissions.
entries.structural_changes: No layer creation/destruction during traversal; callers own structural edits.
entries.events: No gameplay events; visible output is the rendered tile batch.
entries.services: Borrowed Graphics backend and injected dt for animation update.

entries.reason: Map-owned canonical grid captures expose immutable inputs to upper-domain navigation adapters without a Crowd dependency.
protocol: In-process immutable grid capture only; no persistent or cross-process format and no new script binding.
entries.thread_affinity: Map owner thread for capture; source layer is borrowed during the call, capture retains no provider pointers. Immutable data survives provider destruction.

trim.evidence: Crowd core profile has no map provider. Adapter composition is explicitly tested in OBJECT rts+map+crowd; no independent map L2 claim.

cost_notes.why: Stage synchronization and copying before publishing immutable capture. Content-equivalent inputs share data and revision; expensive work is explicit at projection boundaries.
